title: Streamers: Jan 15 is your last 2026 estimate
label: Creator Tax Check

hook.text: Viewers paid you all year in *GTA VI* streams?

items.l: "I'll just pay it all in April"
File by Feb 1 and pay it all? Jan can be skipped

items.t: Set aside for tax + SE tax

captions.instagram:
Viewers paid you all year and no tax was taken out? 🎮 Jan 15, 2027 is the last 2026 estimated payment.

Myth: "I'll just pay it all in April."
Fact: if you expect to owe $1,000 or more after withholding, estimated payments are generally due (Form 1040-ES).

✔️ 4th 2026 payment: Jan 15, 2027.
✔️ File your 2026 return by Feb 1, 2027 and pay everything due? You can skip the January payment.
✔️ Total your tips, subs, bits and ad share now.

Comment STREAM to get your estimate sorted.

Not affiliated with Rockstar Games. General information, not advice for your situation.

sources.fact: Generally pay estimated tax if you expect to owe at least $1,000; Sept 1-Dec 31 period due Jan 15 of the following year
Skip the Jan 15, 2027 payment if you file by Feb 1, 2027 and pay the entire balance
